title: Pollen balances get a clearer split
summary:
Pollen accounting got more legible, legacy text lost default referral links, and Hacktoberfest got its receipts.

Enter added a combined Pollen total with separate tier and pack balances and a daily allowance indicator. Generation requests draw from tier Pollen first, then pack Pollen; a follow-up updated the frontend’s meter configuration.

The legacy text API no longer inserts referral links by default. The explicit p-ads test marker still works.

Publishable keys moved from a three-request bucket to a limiter that accounts for each request’s Pollen charge per key-and-IP pair. Rate-limit headers report Pollen units and retry timing.
